export_metadata.note: HarvestLink's own proposed services are deliberately NOT included — this export represents the estate BEFORE assessment, which is exactly what L1-planning-impact-assessor checks new requirements against. A service-level check here answers 'does something like this already exist' (avoid duplicate build, find the right owner) — a different question from the CMDB's CI-level 'what technical integration touchpoint exists' (see thornbury-cmdb-export.json).
